title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Company:** Aagman Jewels Pvt. Ltd.  
**Industry:** Diamond Jewellery Manufacturing – Platinium

**Department:** Sales  
**Location:** Field-Based – Surat / Assigned Territory  
**Reporting To:** Area Sales Manager / Sales Manager  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years in Field Sales; Jewellery / Diamond Industry Preferred  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiner Preferred

**ROLE PURPOSE**

We are looking for a **proactive and target-driven Field Sales Executive** responsible for generating new business, managing customer relationships, conducting regular market visits and achieving assigned sales targets.

The candidate must be **strong in field execution, customer handling, follow-ups and CRM discipline**.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Sales & Target Achievement**

* Achieve assigned monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Generate new leads and convert them into customers.
* Develop existing customers and drive repeat business.
* Maintain consistent field activity and sales pipeline.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Conduct regular customer visits and build strong business relationships.
* Understand customer requirements and provide appropriate product solutions.
* Ensure timely follow-up on enquiries, quotations, orders and deliveries.
* Handle customer concerns and coordinate for timely resolution.

**Field & Market Development**

* Conduct regular market visits and identify new business opportunities.
* Develop new customers within the assigned territory.
* Maintain strong market coverage and competitor awareness.

**CRM Management & Adherence**

* Update all leads, customer visits, enquiries and follow-ups in CRM on time.
* Maintain accurate customer information and sales pipeline.
* Follow company-defined CRM and sales processes without exception.

**Data, Review & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate daily sales and customer data.
* Submit daily/weekly sales and activity reports.
* Participate in regular performance reviews with the reporting manager.
* Keep management updated on market feedback, opportunities and challenges.

**KEY KPIs**

* **Monthly Target Achievement**
* New Customer Acquisition
* Lead-to-Order Conversion
* Customer Visits & Market Coverage
* Follow-up & Pipeline Management
* CRM Compliance & Data Accuracy
* Customer Satisfaction & Repeat Business
* Daily/Weekly Reporting Discipline

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Target-oriented and self-driven**
* Confident in customer interaction and negotiation
* Comfortable with extensive field work
* Strong in follow-up and relationship management
* Disciplined with CRM and reporting
* Good in communication and presentation
* Able to work independently and as part of a sales team
* **Immediate joiner preferred**

**SUCCESS PROFILE**

**“Be on the Field. Build Relationships. Follow Up Relentlessly. Achieve the Target.”**

**This role is for a hands-on sales professional who is accountable for activity, customer development and measurable business results.**

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
Job description:

Field Sales Executive – Premium Projects

**Company:** HM Technology  
**Location:** Surat | South Gujarat – Vapi, Ankleshwar, Navsari  
**Timing:** 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM  
**Reporting:** Business Development Manager / Sales Head / Director

Role

Focus on identifying **premium projects** such as luxury villas, apartments, commercial spaces, and hotels, and developing contacts with key decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

* Collect **5–7 premium project details daily** with minimum 3 contacts: **Name, Number & Firm**.
* Network with **Architects, Interior Designers, Smart Home/Home Automation Agencies, Builders, Clients, Purchase Managers, Gate Fabricators, Electricians & PMCs/Supervisors**.
* Pitch and invite clients/architects to our **Experience Center & Office**.
* Achieve a target of **150 projects/month**.
* Additional incentive for projects covered beyond the monthly target.

Requirements

* **2–5 years** experience in Field/Outside Sales or Project Sales.
* Marketing/Sales background.
* **Personal Bike/Car + Valid Driving Licence mandatory.**
* Strong cold-calling, territory management & relationship-building skills.

Benefits

* Attractive Industry Salary + Performance Incentives
* Laptop/Desktop, if required
* **Actual Fuel Expenses**
* Visiting Cards & Product Catalogues
* Life & Accident Insurance
* Internet Reimbursement
* Leave Encashment

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant District Sales Manager- Surat Location
description:
**Company Description**  

We take care of our employees, and they take care of our customers!


Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service\-based approach to logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350\+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.


Our Mission


We recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over. **We love to promote from within** \- more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs \- they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!

 **Job Description**  

The focus of the Assistant District Sales Manager is on achieving results that are aligned with the overall organization and it's strategic goals. Initiative, coupled with a sense of competitive drive, and the ability to stay focused on results despite changing conditions, are the keys to achieving the performance objectives of the District Sales Executive role at Expeditors.


The ADSM orchestrates involvement of multiple people in our Sales process, so that new customer revenue is consistently secured for our district office and Expeditors network. The job environment is flexible, constantly changing, and provides growth opportunity, recognition and reward for the achievement of business results. This position reports to the District Sales Manager.

**Key Deliverables**


These are the minimum results expected from a successful District Sales Executive:

* Manage an assigned territory and demonstrate extensive knowledge of potential customers and competitors in this area
* Timely data entry in our Customer Relationship Management tool
* Orchestrate customer / branch relationships and collaborate with regional Product, Service, Geo, and Knowledge Management resources
* Participate in the creation of value\-added solutions for customer's logistics needs, including supporting diagrams and cost\-benefit calculations
* Support the transition of new accounts through customer introductions, information transfer, and securing any necessary customer paperwork. When needed, support AR (accounts receivable) collection.
* Attend training \& development sessions to continue developing selling skills and updating Expeditors Product and Service knowledge
* Involvement in local trade groups, as directed by the District Sales Manager
* Take on additional assignments as required, supporting company needs

  

**Qualifications**  

* Must have at least 3\-5 years of Sales experience in Freight Forwarding industry
* The ability to meet with customers off\-site on a regular basis
* Oral and written proficiency in the English language
* Strong problem solving, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work productively both individually and in a team environment
* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Self\-motivated with ability to work in a fast\-paced and constantly changing environment
* Comfortable with regular data entry on a laptop computer
* Strong rapport and relationship\-building focused
* Empowered to make quick decisions in response to changing conditions
* Extroverted, confident, enthusiastic and persuasive
* Influences others to action
* Timeliness and accountability for results

  

**Additional Information**  

Expeditors offers excellent benefits:

* Paid Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time
* Health Plan: Medical
* Life Insurance
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Training and Personnel Development Program
* Growth opportunities within the company
* Employee Referral Program Bonus
